title: RSI reversion, 14 days
author: arhancanli
rationale: Buys when the relative strength index says a price has fallen unusually fast, and sells as it recovers to the middle of its range. It assumes that sharp falls often partly reverse.
risks: A falling price can keep falling, so it can hold through a long decline. It wins often and small, which hides the size of an occasional large loss.
references: Wilder (1978), New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems, Trend Research
